title: The before-and-after check reads the held names as keyed hashes (Piece 3, P3-5; decisions/0066)
why: Jason, 2026-11-25, Brief B (through the session manager): "verify Decision 0066 via a locked read against live-protected places rather than adding fake test records". A staging-only read, /api/held-hashes.php, locked by the checks' token (HEALTH_TOKEN, as /api/health.php and /api/guide-paths.php), answers the names the site holds back (landmarks waiting, hidden or closed by a nation, through Landmarks::visibleSql; less any name a visible or story-only landmark shares; one-word names left out) as HMAC-SHA256 hashes keyed with that token: never a name or a place, and useless without the token. On the live site it answers nothing (404). The before-and-after check (beforeafter.mjs, repo side, merged with this release) hashes each page's phrases the same way; a held name that shows after a release and didn't before blocks it (rule 1, 0066), named by its hash; when the names can't be read the verdict is incomplete, never a pass. It replaces the plaintext canary list (tools/page-audit/ba-canaries.json, never created). No table, no write, no outside call (R13, R14). It reads protected names, so it's Tier 3 (tribal nations' land) by what it is, and comes to the Founder in the batch. It also names HeldNames and /api/held-hashes.php in TeamRunner::TIER3_AREAS' nations area (0066's existing area, a data entry only; the session manager, 2026-11-26). TIER3_AREAS is in the decision tree's rules, so its fingerprint changes (3b1932228d91 to 0111545cca95) and an approval given before is cleared, agents back at Planning, said in the History; harmless today, since the tree isn't approved and the ceiling is Planning. Found in testing and fixed on the check's side: a page's text read from a detached copy runs neighbouring elements together ("Plan a tripZz Held…"), so the held names are matched against the words as drawn (the live page's innerText).

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
